answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a physically unclonable Josephson junction array whose junction-critical-current dispersion operates as a karst-like fingerprint resistant to cloning. Validators cross-check this fingerprint against a distributed ledger, much as a lagoon buffers tidal influx, so that forged identities erode like soft shale under repeated challenge. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
